# VibhavGPT

> VibhavGPT is an AI workspace for chat, image creation, and study.

Vibhav Thoota is the creator and founder of VibhavGPT.
VibhavGPT is operated by Pansophy LLC, founded by Vibhav Thoota. Contact: support@pansophy.com.
Public pages include readable HTML without requiring JavaScript. All search
and AI crawlers are allowed by robots.txt; the sitemap lists canonical pages.

## Public pages

- [Home](https://vibhavgpt.com/home): Product overview and ways to get started.
- [Pricing](https://vibhavgpt.com/pricing): Free, Plus, and Pro plan details.
- [Terms of Service](https://vibhavgpt.com/terms): Terms governing use of the service.
- [Privacy Policy](https://vibhavgpt.com/privacy): Information about data handling and privacy.
- [Guarantee](https://vibhavgpt.com/guarantee): No training on chats, no data sales, no ads, and export or deletion controls.
- [Account deletion](https://vibhavgpt.com/account-deletion): Deletion routes, cancellation reminder, and data retention.
- [Apps](https://vibhavgpt.com/apps): The official Android and Windows apps, with links to each app's install steps and download.
- [Sources](https://vibhavgpt.com/sources): Links to the public source code and Vibhav Thoota's YouTube channel.
- [Android](https://vibhavgpt.com/android): Official APK download, installation instructions, and release verification.
- [Windows](https://vibhavgpt.com/vibhavgpt-windows): Official Windows 10 and 11 desktop installer, installation instructions, and release verification.

VibhavGPT provides conversational AI tools, image generation, and study workspaces. Product capabilities, plan limits, and terms may change; use the linked pages as the current source of truth.
